latest_deployment_repair.patch: Entrypoint-only production refresh marker plus exact workflow/ledger repair scope. V58 product, V209 router, frozen V51-V57 sources, model/data/math, and widget behavior remain unchanged.

runtime_classifier.reason: Second MAIN public proof after deployment refresh still failed with V58 selection screen not live.

verifier_repair.direct_evidence: Independent public runtime classifier observed V209 live, V58 selection screen=1, V58 cards=2, old V48 players=0. Final verifier still timed out at readiness.
